# Florence X. Doo, MD, MA

> Personal site for Florence X. Doo, a radiologist, clinical AI researcher, and physician innovator focused on safely translating emerging AI systems into clinical practice.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://flo-doo.github.io/): Research, invited talks, current appointments, professional leadership, education and training, collaboration pathways, and contact links.
- [Publications](https://flo-doo.github.io/publications.html): Full publication record with research-area filters and DOI or public-record linkouts.

## Research focus

- Trustworthy Human–AI Systems: evaluation, reliability, human–AI interaction, clinician reliance, fairness, validation, safety, and monitoring.
- Frontier Clinical Intelligence: multimodal AI, generative AI, foundation models, agents, predictive models, and digital twins.
- Sustainable AI & Radiology: efficiency, compute, energy, water, cloud infrastructure, sustainable imaging, and resource use.
- Medical Imaging, Informatics, & Data Systems: imaging informatics, multimodal health data, datasets, interoperability, annotation, benchmarking, and workflow.

## Professional context

Florence Doo is an academic radiologist with current appointments at the University of Maryland School of Medicine, the University of Maryland Institute for Health Computing / Center for Applied AI, and the University of Maryland College of Computer, Mathematical, and Natural Sciences. The site also lists selected national and international professional leadership and invited talks.
